notes: Dynamic notification atom. Composes LottieIcon, Icon, Text atoms — each atom handles its own render mode behaviour. Toast handles layout (pill vs full-width bar), chrome (glow, backdrop-filter, theme), and animation gating. toast.ts is the runtime orchestrator. Icon slugs resolved from Asset Library API at build time.

icon.description: Lottie animation slug from Asset Library API. Library returns paired data (lottie + Phosphor fallback). Pipeline routes: full → LottieIcon atom, reduced/assistive → Icon atom (via fallbackIcon), textonly → hidden (decorative). Toast does not manage routing.

theme.description: Visual theme. Stripped to professional in reduced/assistive/textonly.

animation._description: Motion behaviour — stripped in reduced/assistive/textonly renders

animation.description: Entrance animation. Stripped in reduced render — toast appears instantly.
